description: Search for a whole shopping list in one call: up to 10 queries, each with the search_products filters (5 results each by default). Delivery is free anywhere in Singapore with no minimum spend, so prices shown are delivered prices. Then start_checkout with the chosen variant_ids.

guest_token.description: Optional. Your guest_token from create_cart, if you have one, so this lookup belongs to your shopping session. Not needed to search or read products.

queries.description: One entry per shopping-list item (up to 10), e.g. [{"q": "rice 5kg"}, {"q": "dishwashing liquid", "max_price": 600}]. Each takes the search_products filters.

category.description: Category name or slug, e.g. "pantry" or "skincare".

max_delivery_days.description: Only items delivered within this many Singapore working days (each result shows its estimated_delivery_date).

max_price.description: Highest price in SGD cents (S$40 is 4000).

q.description: Search words, e.g. "cerave cleanser" or "gift for dad under $40". A price phrase sets max_price when it is absent.

sort.description: relevance (default), price (lowest first), price_desc, unit_price (lowest price per 100ml/100g first; items without a comparable size last) or delivery (fastest first).

name: search_products_batch
